# GIAY CHUNG NHAN BAO HIEM CHAY, NO BAT BUOC

## (CAP THEO QUY DINH TAI NGHI DINH SO 67/2023/ND-CP NGAY 06/9/2023 CUA CHINH PHU)

BEN MUA BAO HIEM  CONG TY CO PHAN XUAT NHAP KHAU HUONG GIANG

DIA CHI TRU SO  106 BACH DANG

MA SO THUE  9841329747

HE THONG PHONG CHAY, CHUA CHAY  1,200,000,000

KHO LANH VA THIET BI BAO QUAN  4,700,000,000

NHA KHO VA VAN PHONG  14,300,000,000

TONG SO TIEN BAO HIEM  20,200,000,000

III. PHI BAO HIEM, MUC KHAU TRU VA THOI HAN

TY LE PHI BAO HIEM 0,10%/NAM TREN TONG SO TIEN BAO HIEM, THANH TOAN MOT LAN TRONG VONG 15 NGAY KE TU NGAY CAP

GIAY CHUNG NHAN. MUC KHAU TRU 100.000.000 DONG/VU TON THAT. THOI HAN BAO HIEM 1 NAM KE TU NGAY CAP.

IV. MOT SO NOI DUNG QUAN TRONG

1) DOANH NGHIEP BAO HIEM BOI THUONG CHO THIET HAI XAY RA DOI VOI TAI SAN DUOC BAO HIEM DO CHAY, NO, TRU CAC

TRUONG HOP LOAI TRU TRACH NHIEM BAO HIEM QUY DINH TAI QUY TAC, DIEU KHOAN DINH KEM.

2) BEN MUA BAO HIEM CO TRACH NHIEM CHAP HANH DAY DU QUY DINH CUA PHAP LUAT VE PHONG CHAY VA CHUA CHAY; DUY

TRI HE THONG PHONG CHAY, CHUA CHAY TRONG TINH TRANG HOAT DONG TOT.

3) KHI XAY RA SU KIEN BAO HIEM, BEN MUA BAO HIEM PHAI THONG BAO NGAY CHO DOANH NGHIEP BAO HIEM, GIU NGUYEN

HIEN TRUONG VA PHOI HOP CUNG CAP HO SO THEO YEU CAU.

BEN MUA BAO HIEM  DOANH NGHIEP BAO HIEM

(KY, GHI RO HO TEN, DONG DAU)  (KY, GHI RO HO TEN, DONG DAU)

MOI SUA CHUA TREN GIAY UY QUYEN PHAI CO CHU KY XAC NHAN CUA BEN UY QUYEN

CONG TY CHI CHI TRA SAU KHI DOI CHIEU CHU KY VOI HO SO YEU CAU BAO HIEM
